answer: Production deploys on Fridays are no longer permitted in order to prevent incidents like INC-042 from occurring over the weekend. This restriction, owned by Mei, supersedes Anika's previous schedule from January 2025 which had placed the release window on Friday afternoons. As a result, ordinary release slots have been moved to Tuesday and Thursday mornings.
